items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: Glenn was interviewed on December 7, 2020 via Zoom by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Glenn was interviewed on December 7, 2020 via Zoom by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Glenn Zottola here for a session. And we were just talking about how many memories you have and I’ve been toiling over my first question.
